title: Tolerate missing virtual project paths in the console
description: When a .kanbus.yml lists a virtual project whose path does not exist, every console API call returns HTTP 500 (virtual project path not found) and the UI shows 'Unable to reach the server'. The realtime bridge also restart-loops, printing the same warning with no backoff. Reproduced by running kbsc from /Users/home/Projects/Biased-Decisions, which resolves the parent /Users/home/Projects/.kanbus.yml whose virtual project 'scanner' points at a missing scanner/project. The error comes from rust/src/file_io.rs. Goals: skip a missing virtual project with one clear warning naming its key and path instead of failing every request; stop the realtime bridge from restart-looping on a permanent config error; have kbs doctor report missing virtual project paths; have kbsc say which .kanbus.yml it resolved when it came from a parent directory. Python and Rust parity via shared Gherkin scenarios.
